claims.claim: Observing and describing weather includes sunlight; in strong sun a cap gives shade, while gloves and a scarf are cold-weather clothing.

sources.title: National curriculum in England: science programmes of study (Year 1 seasonal changes)

notes: safety: the item gives sun-protection guidance for strong sun ('ماذا نلبس تحت الشمس القوية؟' -> cap) but the cap is offered as the whole answer and nothing points the child to a trusted adult; add shade/water and 'ask a grown-up' (e.g. a parent or teacher) so the guidance is complete and adult-anchored.
